stories.title: Major breakthrough made on famous Millennium maths problem
stories.summary:
Tristan Buckmaster at New York University and Levent Alpöge at the artificial intelligence company Anthropic have announced three steps toward solving the Navier-Stokes equations. This is one of the world's six remaining Millennium Problems carrying a one million dollar prize from the Clay Mathematics Institute. The equations model fluid flow for aircraft wings, blood flow, and space rockets, but they can break down and output nonsense.

Buckmaster uploaded a document to his website announcing groundbreaking results developed with Alpöge. They claimed three results where two were published with Lean formalisation. This converts mathematical theory into computer code for error checking, while a third awaits finished formalisation. The findings relate to the Boussinesq approximation and the Euler equations instead of wider Navier-Stokes. The work builds on previous research by Diego Córdoba and Luis Martínez-Zoroa using help from large language models from Anthropic and OpenAI.

Buckmaster called the integration of artificial intelligence a Deep Blue-Kasparov moment. He noted that A. I. is rapidly becoming a powerful amplifier of human mathematical effort. David Silvester at the University of Manchester noted that the work on Euler equations shows spontaneous turbulence can appear. He suggested the current findings alone might be enough for the pair to claim the Millennium prize, though expanding it to Navier-Stokes will not be trivial. Terence Tao at the University of California, Los Angeles, stated he would not be surprised if an extension could be achieved by pouring an enormous amount of compute and A. I. assistance at the task. Camilla Nobili at the University of Surrey expressed confidence in the approach, though she believes running the same technique on Navier-Stokes will require more than just that. Silvester added that a working result will not change practical applications because existing fluid dynamics computer models are already exceptionally good.
stories.author: Matthew Sparkes

stories.title: Mistral raises €3B
stories.summary:
Mistral has raised three billion euros in a Series D funding round. The post-money valuation is more than twenty-one billion euros. This is the largest equity fundraising round ever completed by a European technology company. It happened three years after the launch of Mistral. Samsung Electronics led the round. Co-leads include Scaleup Europe Fund managed by E. Q. T. Existing investor P. S. G. Equity also co-led. New investors joining the round include Advent and funds and accounts managed by BlackRock. The Grand Duchy of Luxembourg joined as well. Numerous existing investors participated. They include a one-six-z, A. S. M. L., and N. V. I. D. I. A.

The funding will expand frontier research at Mistral. It will scale compute capacity for training powerful models. It will accelerate commercial growth and widen the international footprint. Mistral currently operates across twenty countries. It supports more than one hundred twenty-five global enterprises. These include Airbus, A. S. M. L., and H. S. B. C. The company states it is the only A. I. company building a full stack of open-weight models. It builds infrastructure and compute capacity. It builds production products to meet growing international demand. This demand is for A. I. performance combined with data governance and independence. It also offers control over infrastructure and the intelligence loop.
stories.author: kuberwastaken

stories.title: Hijacking pirates exploit regional chaos to return to seas off Somalia
stories.summary: Somali piracy off the Horn of Africa has returned to levels unseen in a decade. Regional instability and shipping disruptions are driving this surge. These disruptions are linked to the United States and Israeli war against Iran and Houthi campaigns in the Red Sea. Since late April, there have been eight hijackings. This includes the August capture of the Cameroon flagged Lutuf carrying military equipment for Turkey. The Lutuf was released two weeks later. A joint Turkish and Somali operation destroyed four pirate vessels. Local officials confirmed a two million five hundred thousand dollar ransom was also paid. Matthew Reisener of the Center for Maritime Security spoke on the issue. Global navies once combatting piracy off the Horn of Africa have diverted resources. They now counter threats in critical waterways. These conflicts have drawn maritime traffic closer to the coastline of Somalia. This creates openings for opportunistic pirates to target commercial ships. Reisener noted that about seventy percent of maritime traffic previously passing through the Red Sea is now being rerouted around South Africa. Somalia struggles to secure its coastline. The country has insufficient patrol vessels and an inability to pay coastal patrol salaries. The resurgence has injected cash into local economies such as Galkayo. Experts question whether there is international appetite or capacity for a new counter-piracy naval mission. They compare it to the one deployed in twenty eleven and twenty twelve. Navies worldwide spent more than one billion dollars annually on counter-piracy operations off Somalia back then.
stories.author: Mohamed Gabobe in Mogadishu and Peter Beaumont

stories.title: N-able patches max-severity N-central flaw amid ongoing attacks
stories.summary:
N-able has released an emergency hotfix for a maximum-severity remote code execution vulnerability. The flaw affects the N-central remote monitoring and management platform. It is tracked as C. V. E. dash twenty twenty-six dash eighty-six thousand two hundred eighteen. The flaw allows unprivileged threat actors to execute malicious code on unpatched systems. These online-exposed instances are vulnerable to low-complexity attacks.

N-able addressed the issue on Saturday. They issued N-central twenty twenty-six point three Hotfix four. The company is urging customers to upgrade immediately. The Shadowserver Foundation tracks nearly fifteen hundred N-central servers exposed online. These servers are primarily located in the United States and Europe.

N-able stated it has no confirmations that the vulnerability is being targeted. However, cybersecurity company Huntress flagged it as a potential zero-day. They also flagged two high-severity vulnerabilities tracked as C. V. E. dash twenty twenty-six dash eighty-six thousand two hundred six and C. V. E. dash twenty twenty-six dash eighty-six thousand two hundred seven. These two flaws were also patched over the weekend.

Huntress noted it could not definitively determine if these flaws were responsible for an exploitation. This exploitation was seen in a customer patched production environment. Logs on the compromised server had already rotated. In an advisory, Huntress warned that on-premises users must apply Hotfix four immediately. Systems running Hotfix three remain vulnerable. Customers running on-premises deployments were instructed by N-able to upgrade to N-central twenty twenty-six point three H. F. four immediately to protect their environments.
stories.author: TLDR

stories.title: XPeng starts IRON humanoid robot production as Tesla Optimus stalls
stories.summary: Chinese automaker XPeng has activated the world first automated production line for advanced humanoid robots. The facility is located in Guangzhou. The first IRON robot walked off the line under its own power. Chief Executive Officer, He Xiaopeng stated that the production lines were created from scratch with no precedent. The production setup features more than eighty percent core process automation. It borrows quality systems used for electric cars. The company robotics arm recently raised over nine hundred million dollars. That was at a six point three billion dollar valuation. The funding round was led by, I. D. G. Capital. Tencent and Alibaba also participated. The IRON robot features seventy-six degrees of freedom across its body. It has twenty-one degrees of freedom in each hand. Three in-house Turing A. I. chips power the machine. They deliver up to two thousand two hundred fifty T. O. P. S. These chips run its Physical A. I. foundation model without remote teleoperation. This news matters because XPeng is attempting to solve a difficult challenge. That challenge is consistently manufacturing generalized humanoid robots at scale. XPeng is targeting mass production by the end of twenty twenty-six. Initial deployments are planned for its own stores and campuses. Commercial sales and deliveries will begin in China and abroad in twenty twenty-seven. The company aims to build over one thousand robots a month. This is on the way to one million robots a year by twenty thirty.
stories.author: TLDR

stories.title: Mathspace Discloses Data Breach Affecting Over 1M People
stories.summary:
Attackers stole personal data belonging to one million seventy-nine thousand eight hundred nineteen students, staff, and parents from the online learning platform Mathspace. The breach affected individuals in Australia and New Zealand after intruders compromised an internal reporting system.

Mathspace was founded in Sydney in twenty ten and is used by thousands of schools across multiple countries. Only users in Australia and New Zealand were impacted by this specific security incident.

Chief Technology Officer, Alvin Savoy, explained the timeline in a Saturday blog post. Threat actors gained access to company systems on August tenth. They downloaded data from the Australian reporting database on August twenty-seventh. Company officials confirmed the breach on September third, twenty twenty-six.

The attackers exploited a security vulnerability in a self-hosted installation of a software called Metabase. This flaw allowed intruders to obtain administrator access without using a legitimate login.

The compromised files did not include passwords, authentication tokens, academic records, learning activities, or results. Exposed data did not explicitly link user accounts to specific schools. However, investigators noted that attackers might still connect accounts to schools that use identifiable email domains.

Mathspace warned affected individuals to watch for suspicious account activity because criminals may target them using the stolen information.

This security breach is part of a broader cyber campaign. Attackers have recently exploited database vulnerabilities to target other companies, including Trezor, Framework, and Tally.
stories.author: TLDR

stories.title: PostGREShell: The database powering much of the internet had an open door for 12 years
stories.summary:
Cyera Research has discovered a critical security flaw in PostgreSQL. The vulnerability is tracked as C. V. E. twenty twenty-six dash sixty-four seventy-one. It affects database versions nine point four through eighteen point two. A new tool called PostGREShell turns a low-risk replication credential into a total server compromise. The flaw exists in the database replication protocol. It allows low-privilege accounts to bypass security systems. Attackers can load arbitrary code onto the server and achieve remote code execution. This impacts Windows, Linux, and macOS systems. The vulnerability comes from an unvalidated plugin-loading path used during logical replication. This path never had the security restrictions of standard S. Q. L. plugin loading.

An attacker can exploit this foothold to escalate privileges to full PostgreSQL superuser. They can install persistent backdoors and modify system catalogs directly. They can also execute operating system commands. The vulnerability has been present since twenty fourteen. A threat hunt across VirusTotal identified one hundred fourteen malicious PostgreSQL plugins already in the wild. Cyera Research reported the flaw to the PostgreSQL Security Team on February twenty-first, twenty twenty-six. PostgreSQL acknowledged the report and published a security release fixing the issue on August twenty-second, twenty twenty-six.

Administrators must take action to mitigate the risk. You must apply the security update immediately. You need to audit all replication accounts. You should block outbound S. M. B. port four hundred forty-five from database servers at the firewall. You must also block N. F. S. port twenty forty-nine. Finally, you need to review p. g. underscore h. b. a. dot c. o. n. f. configurations for overly permissive rules.
stories.author: TLDR

stories.title: Oil prices surge as US-Iran strikes intensify in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Oil prices have surged to nearly a six-week high following an escalation of strikes between the United States and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz. On Monday, Brent oil futures rose to hover around ninety-seven dollars a barrel. This marks a nine percent increase over five days. It is approaching the highest point since July twenty-fourth, when prices reached ninety-seven dollars and ninety-three cents. United States West Texas Intermediate crude rose to ninety-two dollars and twenty-seven cents a barrel. The price increases follow United States strikes on three Iranian oil tankers on Saturday. There were corresponding Iranian strikes on three tankers and three United States-linked vessels. There was also a strike on Saudi Aramco facilities in Jizan. Traffic through the Strait of Hormuz has slowed to an average of ten commodity ships per day over the past ten days. The conflict has impacted United States consumers. The national average price for a gallon of petrol reached four dollars and fifteen cents on Monday. That is up from two dollars and ninety-eight cents on February twenty-eighth. United States diesel prices topped five dollars and ninety cents per gallon. This follows an all-time high of five dollars and eighty-five cents last week. American households have spent an average of seven hundred sixty-four dollars and fifty-nine cents on fuel since the war began. This represents four hundred eighteen dollars and eighty-two cents more than usual, according to Brown University data. In Asia, China has insulated itself from the disruption. It has done this by tapping its strategic petroleum reserve. It relies on domestic resources and shifts toward alternative energy sources and electric vehicles. It also sources oil from Russia. As, Rachel Ziemba, of the Center for a New American Security stated, this is a reflection of continued conflict and exchange of fire. She notes that global supply deficits are persisting with little end to the shortages.

stories.title: Oil prices rise to 6-week high after Iran and U.S. trade blows, Saudi Aramco facilities reportedly hit
stories.summary: Oil prices rose to a six-week high on Monday. The United States and Iran traded strikes over the weekend. Tensions in the Middle East increased rapidly. Brent crude oil futures climbed one point five percent to ninety-seven dollars and seventy-three cents per barrel. Prices reached as high as ninety-seven dollars and ninety-three cents. This marks the highest level since July twenty-third. West Texas Intermediate, the US oil benchmark, increased one point eight percent to ninety-three dollars and ten dollars a barrel. This also hit its highest mark since late July. Rising crude prices pushed up the costs of other fuels. Gasoline and diesel reached record highs for a Labor Day weekend. The escalation followed US military strikes on Saturday. The strikes targeted three Iranian oil tankers. Iran had launched ballistic missiles at two US Navy warships. US Central Command stated the three Iranian ships are part of a shadow network. The network is worth billions of dollars and funds Iran's Revolutionary Guard and its regional proxies. The Iranian Foreign Ministry denounced the vessel attacks. They called the action a war crime and an act of economic warfare. Tensions intensified further online. Defense Secretary, Pete Hegseth, posted that the US will destroy and sink Iranian oil tankers if Iran fires on US vessels. This prompted Iranian Parliament Speaker, Mohammad Baqer Qalibaf, to warn the US about striking Iranian assets. Damage was still being assessed at the facility in Jizan. The facility houses a four hundred thousand-barrel-per-day oil refinery. It is not immediately clear who was responsible for the attack. The latest fighting follows about a month of relative calm. The conflict surpassed the six-month mark in August.

stories.title: LPG cylinder rules changed: Refill booking gap cut to 25 days for all consumers
stories.summary:
The government has reduced the minimum gap for booking domestic cooking gas cylinder refills from forty-five days to twenty-five days. Union Minister of State for Petroleum and Natural Gas, Suresh Gopi, announced this change on Monday.

The ministry directed state-run oil companies to implement this uniform twenty-five day interval immediately. The new rule applies equally to both urban and rural areas across the country. Minister Gopi shared a copy of the official ministry letter on Facebook.

Previous booking restrictions started in February twenty twenty-six. The government used those measures to manage high demand during the Middle East conflict when supplies came under severe pressure. The supply situation has improved significantly since then. Refill backlogs have decreased by a considerable amount.

The ministry stated that the present cooking gas supply position is stable. Because backlogs are down, the government decided to revise the existing booking interval. Every domestic consumer now faces a uniform twenty-five day gap between refill bookings.

State-run firms must follow this new rule right away. Those firms include Indian Oil Corporation Limited, Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited, and Hindustan Petroleum Corporation Limited.

Earlier, the government set maximum production targets for twenty-four refinery and upstream oil companies. Those companies have a combined production capacity of sixty-three point eight one thousand metric tonnes per day. The government took that step to bolster domestic cooking gas supplies and enhance resilience against potential disruptions.

stories.title: Russia and North Korea deepen relations with symbolic road bridge
stories.summary:
The first road bridge connecting Russia and North Korea opened on Monday. Flag-adorned trucks crossed the one kilometer, two lane structure spanning the Tumen River. Symbolically named after Red Army soldier, Yakov Novichenko, the bridge was agreed upon during a visit by Russia’s president to North Korea. Construction began in April of last year.

Mishustin stated that up to three hundred vehicles will be able to cross every day. He added that the bridge connects to Russia's federal road network. Cargo transport began immediately. The bridge is scheduled to be fully operational for passenger traffic by the end of the year.

The two countries were previously connected only by air and rail routes. They also share an existing rail link known as the Friendship Bridge, which was commissioned in nineteen fifty-nine. Mishustin said the expansion of cross border transport infrastructure will provide a powerful impetus for further development. He called the opening a genuinely historic event and a new symbol of friendship.

Pak Thae-song stated the bridge will cement cooperation to fulfill the hopes and aspirations of both peoples. The project marks a milestone in relations. These ties have grown considerably stronger and accelerated since Russia launched its war on Ukraine in February of twenty twenty-two. That is a conflict where North Korea sent thousands of troops to Russia's Kursk region.

stories.title: I made a free AI chatbot solve a decade-long maths problem in 13 minutes
stories.summary: A journalist used a free A. I. chatbot to generate a functional mathematical solution for a six-player game. The process took about thirteen minutes and used two clarifying prompts. This milestone matters because it shows regular people can now solve thorny mathematical problems using A. I. chatbots. The problem of finding dice that ensure fair and tie-free throws had occupied a team of human mathematicians for more than ten years. The author sent the A. I. derived solution to Eric Harshbarger at Auburn University in Alabama. He confirmed the numbers were correct. The resulting dice design featured impractical specifications such as five seven hundred twenty-sided dice and one twenty-sided die. Harshbarger and his collaborators had previously adapted their own five-dice solution into a six-dice version using three hundred sixty-sided dice. A search by Google software engineer Paul Meyer showed no trace of the specific solution online. This led researchers to deduce that the A. I. likely located existing published descriptions of the five-dice work and an induction method before filling in the gaps. Harshbarger stated that he thinks it is a big deal. He hates to say there is intelligence there, but it may have figured something out. He added that it is amazing and a little scary in some ways. Sébastien Bubeck at Open A. I. stated that he expects the progress seen in mathematics over the past six months to be matched in the next six months. He noted that current models are still limited to solving existing problems rather than creating entirely new mathematical concepts.

stories.title: The complex corporate web behind a $3.2 billion AI data center
stories.summary:
Early in June, a fire broke out in an unfinished building at the Lake Mariner data center in Somerset, New York.

The fire exposed a lack of local emergency preparedness for the facility.

Firefighters found no working alarm and no suppression system.

They also found three dead hydrants.

Legally mandated safety documents reportedly burned in the blaze.

Matisz noted it has been a difficult situation.

He stated he wasn't sure what to think about the claim that the safety sheets burned in the fire.

The site sits on a former coal mine on Lake Ontario.

It is a three point two billion dollar campus.

The project represents one of the largest artificial intelligence data center buildouts in New York.

Artificial intelligence is spelled A. I.

The project involves multiple stakeholders with a complex corporate structure.

TeraWulf owns and operates the data center.

The company uses land leased from a company owned by its own chief executive officer.

Fluidstack is set to run the center.

Fluidstack is based in the United Kingdom.

Google holds warrants for a future fourteen percent equity stake.

Google has agreed to guarantee Fluidstack’s lease payments.

Anthropic is among the artificial intelligence companies whose compute demand the facility is built to serve.

stories.title: LG smart TVs caught logging audio with screen off and snooping on local devices
stories.summary:
A one hundred thirty-five minute video published by Gamers Nexus reveals a major privacy issue. Retail L. G. O. L. E. D. television models sweep home networks and log microphone audio. These sets continue these actions even while appearing to be powered down in standby mode.

Steve of Gamers Nexus conducted the testing alongside Level1Techs and independent security researchers. Network packet captures using Wi-Fi Shark showed the televisions actively scanning local area networks for unrelated hardware like phones and smartwatches. The sets also gather internal I. P. addresses and neighboring Wi-Fi network names alongside signal strengths and location data.

This collected data feeds directly into L. G. Ad Solutions, which is the targeted advertising arm of the company. L. G. claims roughly two hundred sixteen million smart T. V. sales globally. Their ad division states it has access to three hundred sixty-three million secondary addressable devices in the United States alone by tracking other hardware on the same network.

The sets also run Automated Content Recognition. This software samples on screen audio and video into digital fingerprints to log what users watch across all inputs. During bench tests, researchers found the T. V. could capture clean microphone audio while the screen looked powered down.

When disconnected from Ethernet, the set continued saving voice input locally. It then uploaded the stored files once network access was restored. Because the televisions use broad network listeners and data sweeps right out of the box, the team made a clear recommendation. They suggest disconnecting L. G. sets from the internet and using external streaming devices instead. L. G. has not commented on the findings.
